summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, reporting a press release dated August 12, 2026, regarding its humanitarian response to an earthquake in western Colombia on August 10, 2026. The filing details that no personnel injuries or asset damage occurred, and the company is providing monetary and in-kind contributions to local organizations, including the Red Cross, National Federation of Coffee Growers, and ANDI, to support recovery efforts. This is a routine operational and community update, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic transaction. No deal terms apply.
